names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 22 februarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 22 Φεβρουαρίου, «Όσιοι Θαλάσσιος και Λιμναίος», with the rank words left off.
Read out of the Охридски пролог's third heading for 22. фебруар ст. ст., „Преподобни Таласије и Лимније.“, which gives the two bare forenames under one rank word and no epithet for either.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 februarie — «Sfântul Cuvios Talasie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιοι Θαλάσσιος και Λιμναίος»

attestations.note: One page for the two of them, which rests them on Theodoret of Cyrrhus and the Synaxarion of Constantinople. It gives no year for either and prints no hymn. Thalassius's hermitage is put on a small mountain of a village of Cyrrhus called Tillimas.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.03.2026 (22. фебруар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Таласије и Лимније.“

attestations.note: The Prologue's third heading names the two hermits together, so this row and `limnaeus`'s quote the same line.

death.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 22 February dates his death inside the sentence about his companion: „По смрти светог Таласија 440. Лимније пређе ка светом Марону.“ The folder carried no dates at all before this reading.
